Lucille Marie Eldridge December 9, 1938 - September 17, 2026
Lucille Marie (Davis) Eldridge was born on December 9, 1938. She passed away on September 17, 2026, at the age of 87.
Lucille was the daughter of Herbert and Dorothy Davis. She grew up in Bunker Hill, Illinois, with her siblings, Deloris, Cleda, and Tom. Bunker Hill was where she made lifelong friends, met her husband, and raised her eight children.
Lucille had a love for gardening, canning, planting flowers, rescuing animals, writing articles for magazines, sewing, helping others, and spending time with her family, grandchildren, and friends. She also enjoyed keeping in touch with friends and family through Facebook.
Lucille attended the Free Methodist Church in Bunker Hill, Illinois. She earned her CNA degree from Lewis and Clark College and worked as an EMT in Bunker Hill. She also worked as a CNA in several nursing homes.
She is survived by her children, Dale Smith; Diana (Stephen, deceased) Chestnut; Donna (Jeannie) (Tim) Hancock; Gary (Juanita, deceased) Eldridge; and Steve (Josie) Eldridge; as well as many grandchildren, great-grandchildren, and great-great-grandchildren; nieces and nephews; and her sister-in-law, Linda Rice. She was preceded in death by her parents; siblings; her husband, Donald Eldridge; daughters Sharyne (Kim) Parnell, Sandra Eldridge, and Laurie Winfree; and grandchildren Christopher and DJ Winfree.
The family will hold a small graveside service on October 24, 2026, at 10:00 a.m. at Bunker Hill Cemetery, followed by a Celebration of Life at the Bunker Hill Community Center at 11:00 a.m.
